summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing positive topline results from the Phase 3 EPCORE DLBCL-2 trial of subcutaneous epcoritamab plus R-CHOP in newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma patients with IPI 2-5. The combination reduced risk of progression or death by 51% (HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.36-0.67, p=0.0001) versus R-CHOP alone, with a generally well-tolerated safety profile. Genmab and partner AbbVie will engage global regulatory authorities on next steps, with data to be submitted for a future medical meeting. This is a clinical/regulatory milestone rather than a special-situation corporate event.
